purpose: Test whether a fixed, interpretable multi-signal chain representation learned only on disjoint calibration cases can separate complete low-confidence chains from genuinely broken chains better than direct, bottleneck-only and two-signal controls.

prior_boundary.v67_aggregate_diagnosis: A single bottleneck threshold recovered answerable chains but also admitted too many unanswerable chains.

sources.official_schema_source: raw_data_to_official_format.py at the registered repository revision

calibration.ordering: SHA-256('FRC-MUSIQUE-V68-CALIBRATION|' + source id), then source id

development.ordering: SHA-256('FRC-MUSIQUE-V68-DEVELOPMENT|' + source id), then source id

confirmation.ordering: SHA-256('FRC-MUSIQUE-V68-CONFIRMATION|' + source id), then source id

sampling.pair_assignment: SHA-256('FRC-MUSIQUE-V68-PAIR-ASSIGNMENT|' + source split + '|' + source id) parity assigns each source id to exactly one answer state before stage selection

oracle_plan_boundary.interpretation: This remains an oracle-plan component experiment, not an automatic decomposition result.

blind_execution.direct_score: Maximum finite composed-question null-vs-span margin across paragraphs with deterministic paragraph-order tie breaking.
chain_execution: Process every official decomposition question in list order without an intermediate margin threshold.
Resolve each #k placeholder only with the fixed model span predicted at prior hop k; never use gold or aliases.
At every hop select the paragraph/span with maximum finite margin and deterministic paragraph-order tie breaking.
Fail closed only when a predecessor cannot be resolved or no valid finite span exists.

definitions.margin_scaling: clip raw margin to [-10,10], then divide by 10; no learned preprocessing
definitions.high_margin_fraction: fraction of chain hops with margin strictly greater than 0.974609375
definitions.transition_entity_match_fraction: fraction of adjacent hops where the normalized prior predicted span, requiring at least three alphanumeric characters, appears as a contiguous normalized substring in the next selected paragraph
definitions.distinct_selected_paragraph_ratio: distinct selected paragraph indices divided by hop count
definitions.direct_final_paragraph_agreement: 1 iff the direct selected paragraph equals the final-hop selected paragraph, otherwise 0
definitions.hop_indicators: fixed indicators for 3-hop and 4-hop chains; 2-hop is the reference

model_contract.initialization: all coefficients and intercept exactly zero

threshold_selection.candidate_thresholds: Every unique finite calibration score plus nextafter(minimum score, -infinity); decisions always use score > threshold.
threshold_selection.selection_rule: If any threshold meets both constraints, maximize balanced accuracy, then answerable pass rate, unanswerable rejection rate, and threshold. Otherwise minimize total safety shortfall, then maximize balanced accuracy, unanswerable rejection rate, and threshold.
threshold_selection.crossfit_diagnostic: Five folds assigned by SHA-256('FRC-MUSIQUE-V68-CROSSFIT|' + case id) modulo 5; model weights and threshold for each held-out fold are learned only from the other four folds.

fair_comparators: two-signal projected logistic using only direct and chain-min features

primary_metric.name: answerability balanced accuracy
primary_metric.strongest_fair_baseline: the single comparator with highest aggregate balanced accuracy; ties use the ordered comparator list above
primary_metric.paired_delta: multisignal candidate correctness minus strongest fair baseline correctness
primary_metric.interval: 10000-resample case bootstrap percentile interval using the stage seed

stopping_and_outcomes.calibration: Freeze all reported model weights and thresholds; calibration alone never authorizes adoption.

interpretation_limits: Not an official MuSiQue leaderboard result.
Not an automatic decomposition result because the official decomposition question plan is supplied.
Not an FRC retrieval comparison, SetR reproduction, flood-domain evaluation or production result.
A positive confirmation establishes only calibrated oracle-plan multi-signal support-gate component feasibility.
